title: Fixed-width binary representations of addition
statement: For any natural numbers $m$ and $n$, there is a width $k$ such that the concatenation of their length-$k$ binary representations and the length-$k$ binary representation of $m+n$ belongs to the language of addition; in this language, the three blocks have equal length and the value represented by the third block is the sum of the values represented by the first two.
